summary: Cook County steel ladder tower built about 1932 by the Forest Service; survey notes say it was dismantled by 2008. The lake it overlooked is in wilderness.

notes_for_editor: The 1932 build year is corroborated by two lists. The 2025 compilation's Kelso entry says both 'A ladder tower erected in 1932' (the evidence quote, verbatim) and 'A ladder tower erected around 1932' (its own inconsistency); the story uses 1932 without 'around'. Story fix 2026-10-10: the third source is the Forest Lookouts site (centraluslookouts.weebly.com), not 'Central Lookouts'. The 1934 90-foot figure and the 2008 dismantling note sit inside the Kelso entry of the compilation. The 'Sawbill' alias appears only in that compilation and is unconfirmed. The Cook County compilation at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/fe/Cook_County_Towers.pdf carries the same entry (read, not cited). The Kelso Lake Wikipedia page is a stub, used only for wilderness status. No source describes what remains at the site today or whether it is open to visitors, so the story says so and the access note is limited to the canoe-route description.
